pricing.title: Access administrative excellence without compromise.
pricing.subtitle: We're making public services in Cameroon accessible to everyone. Our Level 1 (AI Assistant) is entirely free and unlimited.
pricing.tier1Subtitle: Instant access to every procedure sheet and 24/7 conversational help.
pricing.tier2Subtitle: Talk to an expert to validate your case.
pricing.tier3Subtitle: We handle everything, from filing to final delivery of your document. Total peace of mind for complex cases.
pricing.tier3Note: Pricing note: Prices shown for full delegation are indicative. The final price depends on case complexity, procedure type and requested timelines. A final quote is always provided before any payment.
pricing.faq1A: We accept payments via Mobile Money (MoMo) and Orange Money. Transactions are secure and confirmed instantly.
pricing.faq2A: Absolutely. We use certified payment gateways. No secret PIN is ever requested outside of the official platform.
pricing.faq3A: If your case is found not to be feasible after initial review, we issue a full refund of our service fees (excluding operator fees).
pricing.finalCtaSubtitle: Contact us directly to confirm your request and finalize your secure payment.

about.title: Our mission
about.intro: Ma Procédure was born from a simple observation: in Cameroon, understanding and completing an administrative procedure often takes longer than the procedure itself. We want to change that.
about.missionText: We centralize official information on Cameroonian administrative and semi-administrative procedures, and connect citizens with a network of verified experts to assist them whenever needed.
about.value1Desc: A first level of information that's always free and available 24/7.
about.value2Desc: Verified content, regularly updated, never approximate.
about.value3Desc: Less travel, less waiting, more clarity.
about.value4Desc: Your data and payments protected at every step.
about.ctaText: Whether you're a citizen or an expert, discover how Ma Procédure can support you.
